texts.orig: 2.3. Model Checking

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Besnard and Doutre [12] give a method of model checking. The method aims to translate an AF as propositional formula in the PL2; such that the models of the propositional formula are corresponding to extensions of the AF under a kind of semantics. In fact, the core of each model is an extension of the AF and vice versa. The translating functions depend on various semantics. The mainly results in the chapter model checking" in [12] are listed as the following; where $ is a translating function. each
